recap_md: Nick, the narrator, has moved East to learn the bond business, settling in West Egg across the bay from the fashionable East Egg. He's just arrived to visit his old classmate Tom Buchanan - a wealthy, physically imposing former football star - at Tom's East Egg mansion.

Nick has settled in West Egg to learn the bond business and visited his wealthy cousin Daisy and her husband Tom in East Egg. Over dinner with Daisy's friend Jordan Baker, Gatsby's name comes up in passing, and Tom launches into an anxious rant defending a racist book about civilization's decline. Jordan quietly tells Nick that Tom has a woman in New York.

Nick has moved to West Egg for the bond business and visited his cousin Daisy, her husband Tom, and felt the strain of Tom's hinted-at affair over a tense dinner. Daisy, disillusioned, says she hopes her daughter grows up to be 'a beautiful little fool.' Nick recalls a cheating scandal linked to Daisy's friend Jordan Baker. Driving home, Nick catches his first glimpse of his mysterious neighbor Gatsby, standing alone and reaching toward a green light across the water.
